persona: Industrial controls hardware engineer moving into senior board design
resumeText:
Rohan Kulkarni | Pune | rohan.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Hardware Engineer, Sahyadri Power Controls, Pune (2019 - present)
- Designed schematics in Altium Designer for 6-layer controller boards built around STM32 microcontrollers.
- Designed 24V to 5V and 3.3V DC-DC converter stages and simulated them in LTspice before layout.
- Brought up every new board in the lab with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer.
- Added CAN and RS-485 interfaces between the controller and field sensors.
- Prepared bills of materials and worked with the layout vendor on DFM fixes.

EDUCATION
BE Electronics and Telecommunication, College of Engineering Pune, 2019

SKILLS
Digital electronics, KiCad, Embedded C
